$comment: The seat every install gets: the room's own, which ships with the plugin. A worker seat comes from the model table (room/models.json, a project's own table) or from what this machine added (setup.json). Harnesses: claude, codex, pi, opencode; any harness can hold any role.
$comment_restrictModels: true: each provider lists only the models room/models.json assigns to it (read from the harness's live catalog when the room is set up). false: the harness's full model list.
